conclusion: Low-rank RRQR or truncated SVD approximations replace L to reduce the cost of gradient and Hessian evaluations.
scope: Approximate likelihood matrix and derivatives; does not establish equality with exact-L estimates.
span: In practice, we find that L LL is often numerically rank deficient, with (numerical) rank r<m r<mr<m. We can exploit this property to reduce computational effort by approximating L LL with a low-rank matrix. We use either the RRQR decomposition (Golub & Van Loan, 2012) or a truncated singular value decomposition (tSVD) to compute an accurate, low-rank approximation to L LL.
